derivation:
by_cases ha : p a
· rw [cfc_apply f a, cfc_apply g a]; exact cfcHom_mono ha fun x ↦ h x.1 x.2
· grind
explanation: `cfcHom_mono` proves monotonicity for the bundled continuous maps on the spectrum. When `p a` holds, `cfc_apply` identifies the unbundled `cfc`s with those maps restricted to the spectrum. When `p a` fails, both `cfc`s have the junk value zero, as discharged by `grind`. The target proof already applies `cfcHom_mono` in its `p a` case.
